description:
## Return YouTube Username v2.1.0

- Pure Standalone Morphe Patch Bundle: Only contains Return YouTube Username without duplicating official patches.
- Zero conflict: seamlessly loads and patches alongside official Morphe patches.
- Independent Settings Menu: Dedicated 'Return YouTube Username' screen in Morphe settings.
- Replace YouTube @handles with original channel names in comments, Shorts, and across the app.
- Zero-configuration out of the box (public handle scraper) + optional YouTube Data API v3 key.
- Persistent disk caching (SharedPreferences) + fast in-memory LRU cache.
- Preserves Litho formatting spans and author badges.
- Fully compatible with Morphe 2.1.0 and YouTube 21.30.216.
